hero.claim: Porsche 997. Irish Green. Engineering RUF Kompressor.

intro.titulo:
A documented
chapter of the
RUF legacy.
parrafos: Originally delivered in 2007 through Porsche Zentrum Essen, this 911 Carrera 4S, 997 generation, began its journey as a sophisticated Gran Turismo in Meteor Gray Metallic (LM7W) with a Classic Dark Brown leather interior.

In 2011, with only 12.234 km on the odometer, its first owner sent the car to the RUF Automobile facility in Pfaffenhausen for a comprehensive conversion to the Kompressor R specification. This transformation, with a cost of 55.000 €, is meticulously documented by the original RUF invoice.
The car retains its original chassis number from Porsche. The original VIN.
intro.cita: It's not just a prepared Porsche. It is a documented RUF conversion, carried out in Pfaffenhausen and retaining its original Porsche VIN.

parrafos: The RUF Kompressor system changes the character of the flat-six without the abrupt response of a conventional Turbo. By combining Kompressor forced induction with an intercooler, RUF achieved linear power delivery that eliminates lag typical of conventional turbochargers.
The power is delivered immediately and precisely, reinforcing the Gran Turismo sports car character of the base 997 Carrera 4S.
Transmission: gearbox manual 6 speeds. Drive: all-wheel drive AWD system.

exterior.texto: In 2024, this RUF underwent a cosmetic rebirth at Valentin Motors. With an investment of more than 30.000 €, the vehicle was completely stripped down and repainted in the iconic Irish Green, a shade that pays tribute to the most legendary heritage of RUF and Porsche. The Irish Green turns this unit into a visually contained but deeply recognizable piece.

interior.editorial: The interior combines the sobriety of brown leather with green textile details and specific RUF components. The instrumentation, steering wheel and sills turn the cabin into a direct extension of the Kompressor R conversion, maintaining an artisanal and technical reading.

hitos.titulo: Original delivery at Porsche Zentrum Essen
hitos.cuerpo: This 911 Carrera 4S, generation 997, is delivered by Porsche Zentrum Essen in color Meteor Gray Metallic (LM7W) on Classic Dark Brown leather interior. Country of first delivery: Germany.

With only 12.234 km, the vehicle is sent to RUF Automobile in Pfaffenhausen for a comprehensive Kompressor R conversion. The transformation includes supercharger, intercooler, tires, brakes, suspension, exhaust and body RUF. The car retains its original VIN Porsche.

Valentin Motors carries out an aesthetic and mechanical renovation of more than 30.000 €: complete dismantling, repainting glass-out in Irish Green, deep renovation of the interior, major technical inspection and complete service. Body fully verified at Valentin Motors.

hitos.titulo: A collector's item ready to drive
hitos.cuerpo: 52.492 km totals. MOT valid until January 2027. No accidents. Matching numbers. servicing complete with stamps from Porsche and RUF specialists. 3 owners. Location: Spain.

opinion.bio: More than 25 years of experience with collectible Porsche. He has supervised hundreds of special vehicle purchase and sale operations, with special focus on preparations.
opinion.intro: "We have been looking for a RUF Kompressor R in similar condition to this one for many years. When we saw it, the decision was immediate."
parrafos: The first thing that catches your attention about this car is not the paint, although the Irish Green on a polished concrete floor is almost unfairly beautiful. What is engaging is the coherence of the whole. Each element speaks the same language: the conversion RUF, the renewal of 2024 in Valentin Motors, the short lever, the green box with the red needles. Nothing is out of place.

The RUF Kompressor system radically changes the 997’s personality without betraying its character. There is no turbo lag. Boost builds cleanly and progressively, and the 3,8-litre flat-six responds with a linearity few cars of this power can match. With its 6-speed manual gearbox and all-wheel drive, the result is a Gran Turismo you can drive without restriction in any conditions.

The record is impeccable. Three owners, original VIN Porsche, invoice RUF from 2011, complete documentation of the restoration from 2024. For a serious collector, that's as important as the car itself.
pros: Genuine, documented and certified RUF conversion
Manual transmission in an all-wheel drive RUF: exceptional combination
Irish Green is practically unique on the market today
Three documented investments that justify the price
contras: The price places this RUF in the realm of a collector, not an everyday user
A more extreme profile may prefer the CTR or RGT of the same era
